package plantedsplit

func fillNested(h holder) { h.d.Code = "planted_split_nested" }

func fillEmbedded(w *wrapped) { w.Code = "planted_split_embedded" }

func fillEmbeddedSelector(o outerWrap) { o.inner.Code = "planted_split_embedded_selector" }

func fillPromoted(w wrapped) { w.DetailedError.Code = "planted_split_promoted" }

func fillAliased(a *aliased) { a.Code = "planted_split_aliased" }

func fillDefined(n *defined) { n.Code = "planted_split_defined" }

type notCarrier struct{ Code string }

type definedOther notCarrier

func fillDefinedOther(n *definedOther) { n.Code = "not_a_problem" }

func fillPromotedAliased(w aliasedWrap) { w.DetailedError.Code = "planted_split_promoted_aliased" }
